attribute_fields.COMMENTS: WestVirginia state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per W. Va. Code § 11-21-4e: tax = max(AGI - $0 std ded, 0) x 4.82%. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " WestVirginia Tax Calculation (top marginal 4.82%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 0.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0482
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 f- 0.0 fmax /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0482 f* /result.computed_state_tax xdef " WV taxable income (AGI - $0): $" result.computed_state_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " WV state tax (top marginal 4.82%): $" result.computed_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: WV: 4.82% x max(AGI - $0, 0) per W. Va. Code § 11-21-4e
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "WestVirginia top-marginal-rate approximation per W. Va. Code § 11-21-4e"
